data.rationale: Four authorized focused offline Worker behavior tests passed and the prior evidence failure is fixed; advance to independent static review with factual untested scenarios retained.
data.exceptions: Explicit exception for requirements coverage below 70% (2/32) and unavailable branch coverage; unexecuted scenarios are not counted as passed. Reviewer must inspect file preservation, path bounds, revision binding, target selection, YAML fallback, serialization and evidence consistency.
data.residual_risk: UI/API, SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations, Git Clone, additional Worker adapters and concurrency lack independent runtime evidence; DB/filesystem operations are non-atomic. This decision does not authorize production release.
